notes: Store meta: Rad Revolution, Lake Stevens, Washington, USD, 'Bags that aren't boring', ships to CA and US (https://radrevolutionkids.com/meta.json, redirects to radrevshop.com). About: designer-owner Mallory started the brand 'to provide moms with high quality, gender neutral baby items that will last'; 'We manufacture across the world' (https://www.radrevshop.com/pages/about).

Free US shipping over $75; ships via USPS from the Seattle area. Returns: unused bags within 30 days of delivery, for shop credit only (no refunds); discounted items final sale; a $15 damage fee if poorly packed and 50% store-credit deduction for signs of use; limit 5 returns a year (https://www.radrevshop.com/pages/returns-exchanges). Mega Cloud: 'Made from your favorite nylon cloud material', water-bottle side pockets, buckle strap to clip over a stroller (products.json).
